mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market tightness that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.8 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1800.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 110.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in the real economy, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption expenditures and residential investment signals broad-based demand strength, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances where both PAYEMS and HOUST are rising, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation and a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is rising and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, which increases wage growth and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 index level combined with a rising unemployment rate signals a manufacturing contraction and labor market deterioration, which triggers recessionary fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and UNRATE > 4.8%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
